name: Atlas (all-electric)
summary: Boston Dynamics replaced its hydraulic Atlas with an all-new electric version one day after retiring the old one, in April 2024. The electric Atlas has joints that rotate continuously rather than copying human range of motion, is aimed at Hyundai factory work, and by 2025 was shown running and doing part-sequencing tasks under learned policies.
notable: Boston Dynamics' switch from hydraulic to electric actuation
